svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Made as two half shells, front and back, that close round the barrel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (it cannot slide on over the nozzle). Each half, 217 mm long:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guard: 1 mm perforated steel rolled to a half tube 116 mm across.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skin: 0.5 mm aluminium rolled to a half tube 60 mm across.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fill between with 25 mm mineral wool rated above 600 degrees C; close

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the ends and the two split faces with aluminium strip, riveted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back half: a 20 x 40 mm notch in skin and wool at each heater band,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for its leads and terminal block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hanger tabs: two per half, 16 x 14 mm, 2 mm steel, riveted to the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge pointing out at 45 degrees to the split (132 mm circle);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each half hangs from the shelf on two M5 screws through 14 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spacers; the halves meet left and right; bottom edge 6 mm above the hex.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the guard does not touch the barrel or the heaters anywhere.
